description.en: RDF version of the Apertium bilingual dictionary EN-ES The original dataset (in LMF) comes from http://hdl.handle.net/10230/17096. The RDF version of the lexica is modelled using lemon (http://lemon-model.net/) and the translation module (http://purl.org/net/translation). More about the Apertium RDF dictionaries at http://linguistic.linkeddata.es/apertium/

contact_point.name: Universitat d'Alacant. Grup Transducens ; Paul Breen ; Jimmy O'Regan ; Universitat Pompeu Fabra. Institut Universitari de Lingüística Aplicada (IULA)

other_download.title: Zipped Dump
other_download.description: It contains two lexicons (EN, CA), a Translation Set EN-CA, and the metadata file.

other_download.title: English lexicon URI
other_download.description: This online lexicon not only contains the EN lexical entries from the EN-CA bilingual dictionary (that can be found in the zipped dump) but also aggregates the lexical entries in EN coming from all the published Apertium RDF dictionaries.

other_download.title: Catalan lexicon URI
other_download.description: This online lexicon not only contains the CA lexical entries from the EN-CA bilingual dictionary (that can be found in the zipped dump) but also aggregates the lexical entries in CA coming from all the published Apertium RDF dictionaries.
